paragraphs.text: Grace moves first: it shows you the whole world as already His — all of it, with nothing left out, right now. Only then comes the second move, said out loud and flat: Maheśa is always my own self, and through Him everything is mine.

So the order matters: appearance first, ownership second. Grace shows the world as His before identity dares to claim it. That two-step — disclosure, then declaration — is exactly what non-dual recognition is.
